camera.reason: 13MP f/1.85 main camera with an auxiliary lens, no OIS.

performance.reason: Entry Unisoc chip with only 2GB RAM will lag in daily use.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 10W charging is slow to refill.

display.reason: 6.6 inch HD+ LCD at 90Hz with 500 nits peak.

build.reason: Plastic back and frame with no IP rating.

software.reason: Android 14 Go edition with no published OS update commitment.

value.reason: At 23,500 it costs more than the Smart 9 HD and Spark Go 1 yet has half their RAM.

availability.reason: Out of stock at PriceOye today and not listed on Infinix Pakistan's site; official warranty where sold.

notes: Price is the WhatMobile official price (23,499). PriceOye lists the 2GB 64GB at 22,499 but out of stock on 2026-10-10. Infinix's own spec sheet (Kenya) lists a 3GB 64GB model; the Pakistan listings are 2GB 64GB. The chipset is not named by Infinix or GSMArena; Infinix lists 2x A75 at 1.6GHz with Mali-G57 MC1. Infinix Pakistan's site does not list this phone, so the photo is from Infinix Kenya. No published update policy.
